pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices and softened, blurred pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is heterogeneous, with smaller, more circular clusters at the base of the neck and larger, more elongated geometric shapes along the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections. The thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with slight narrowing at the dorsal-most junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck. The mane presents as a continuous, slightly textured fringe against the background with minimal vertical protrusion.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical skin fold at the base of the neck where it meets the shoulder, creating a deep shadowed groove that bifurcates several patches.
